product.description: Trusted RELIABILITYMonoprice™ SLIMRUN™ CAT6 REINFORCED ETHERNET PATCH CABLES are designed for high‑density environments where space is a premium. SlimRun's ultra‑slim 0.149‑inch diameter 30AWG cable and narrow boot design reduces congestion and simplifies moves, additions, and changes. Heavily reinforced and protected strain relief provides the maximum protection and durability for applications requiring repeated use.Monoprice™ Ethernet cables are made of 100% pure bare copper wire, as opposed to copper clad aluminum (CCA) wire, and are therefore fully compliant with UL® Code 444 and National Electrical Code® TIA‑568‑C.2 fire and safety standards, which require pure bare copper wire in communications cables. SlimRun™ Cat6 Reinforced 30AWG UTP Ethernet Network Cable0.149 inches diameterReduces congestion in high density spacesUltimate protectionLifetime warrantyLengths:0.5, 1, 2, 3, 5, 7, 10, 14, 20, 25, 30, and 50 feet Monoprice Lifetime Warranty on All CablesBuy with ConfidenceSLIMRUN CAT6 DESIGNSlimRun™ Cat6 is much thinner and lighter than standard Cat6 cables. The 0.149‑inch diameter, 30AWG flexible cable and snagless narrow boot design is easier to install/uninstall and takes less space than conventional 23 or 24 AWG Cat6 cables.SUPERIOR PERFORMANCESlimRun™ Cat6 patch cables are component tested, providing superior performance in 1 to 10 Gigabit applications. SlimRun is the perfect solution for high‑performance applications, such as data centers and telecommunications rooms.HIGH DENSITY ENVIRONMENTS ‑ SAVE SPACE, SAVE MONEYAt half the size of standard Cat6 patch cables (0.149" v 0.29"), SlimRun™ Cat6 helps reduce congestion in high‑density environments, such as data centers and telecommunications rooms.
